text.title: BitMotor text
text.paragraph: A paragraph wraps by itself inside its width. Tab: align it left, centred or right. + and -: text scale.

dialogue.0: Hello! I am a [gold]typewriter[/]. I write letter by letter, and I stop at the full stops.
dialogue.1: Press [sky blue]Space[/] to see the whole line at once, or to read the next one.
dialogue.2: Accents work too: ¿qué tal? ¡Olé! Ça va? Über… 100 €.

jfx.about.text: UI::JFxStyle: aesthetics inspired by JavaFX (Modena), immediate like the rest of BitMotor's UI.
